pool-runner-pairing.title: Pair execution machine
pool-runner-pairing.intro: Create a short-lived request. The target machine keeps its own credential; you review its fingerprint before approval.
pool-runner-pairing.name: Registered node name
pool-runner-pairing.defaults: Defaults: 1 slot and 86,400 seconds (24 hours). Review them before creating the request.
pool-runner-pairing.stale: Read the current request again before continuing.
pool-runner-pairing.fingerprint_help: Compare this entire SHA-256 fingerprint with the one displayed on the intended machine. Its reported name alone is not proof of identity.
pool-runner-pairing.identity_help: Leave empty to use the dedicated Pool identity location in the system user configuration directory. An explicit path must be absolute. The token stays in the machine credential store.
pool-runner-pairing.command: Run explicitly on the target machine
pool-runner-pairing.command_incomplete: Choose the target shell. If supplying an identity path, use an absolute path.
pool-runner-pairing.copy_failed: Copy failed. Select and copy the displayed command manually.
pool-runner-pairing.confirm: I compared the full fingerprint and reviewed the name, slots, lifetime and control URL for this exact proposal.
pool-runner-pairing.approved: Credential registered for this Pool node:
pool-runner-pairing.pending: The original operation acknowledgement is unknown. Check that same operation; do not create a replacement identity.
pool-runner-pairing.boundary: Pairing does not create a project grant, run a Worker, report tool inventory or enable task dispatch. Registration is not online status. No token is shown or stored in the browser.
pool-runner-pairing.invalid_read: The server returned an invalid Pool pairing response. Read the original request again.
pool-runner-pairing.invalid_locator: The saved public locator is invalid. Select the original request from current authorized history, or reconcile its retained original operation.
pool-runner-pairing.locator_failed: The public request locator could not be saved. The original operation remains available for reconciliation.
pool-runner-pairing.query_invalid: Use a valid status and a search of at most 120 UTF-8 bytes.
pool-runner-pairing.reason.pool_changed: The Pool policy changed. This original request cannot be approved.
pool-runner-pairing.reason.pool_inactive: The Pool is not active. Approval is unavailable.
pool-runner-pairing.reason.credential_un: The original credential is no longer available. An old approval cannot restore it.
pool-runner-pairing.reason.control_chang: The control URL changed. Verify the original request before continuing.
pool-runner-pairing.reason.expired: The pairing request expired; no credential was renewed.
pool-runner-pairing.access_changed: Current Pool access could not be confirmed. Observations are hidden; the original operation remains available for reconciliation.
pool-runner-pairing.reset_help: This resets only this local public selection. Existing server requests and the original operation journal remain unchanged.
pool-runner-pairing.reset_failed: The local public selection could not be reset. The original operation is preserved.
